question: Build a balance-sheet comp table for four U.S. retailers: TJX Companies, Ross Stores, Lowe's and Tractor Supply. Use each company's latest reported balance sheet as of October 3, 2026 (the most recent 10-Q or 10-K) and state its balance-sheet date. Report, in USD millions: (1) cash and cash equivalents (exclude short-term investments and restricted cash); (2) total debt = current portion of long-term debt + long-term debt (non-current portion), as presented on the face of the balance sheet, excluding operating lease liabilities, separately presented finance lease liabilities and any commercial paper or short-term borrowings; (3) net debt = total debt - cash and cash equivalents (a negative number means net cash).
grading: Graded cell by cell: each value within tolerance and for the stated period; a missing cell counts as wrong.

output.answer:
## Important premise correction

No U.S. retailer among these four has a reported balance sheet dated **October 3, 2026**. As of the date of these filings, each company's most recent 10-Q covers a summer-2026 quarter, and none files a quarter ending October 3, 2026 (that date isn't a fiscal quarter-end for any of them, and no such 10-Q exists). Below I use each company's **actual latest reported balance sheet** and state its date.

## Balance-sheet comp table (USD millions)

| Company | Balance-sheet date | (1) Cash & cash equivalents | (2) Total debt¹ | (3) Net debt² |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| The TJX Companies | Aug 1, 2026 (Q2 FY2027 10-Q) | 6,004 | 2,871 | **(3,133)** |
| Ross Stores | Aug 1, 2026 (Q2 FY2026 10-Q) | 4,288 | 1,018 | **(3,270)** |
| Lowe's Companies | Jul 31, 2026 (Q2 FY2026 10-Q) | 3,172 | 37,556 | **34,384** |
| Tractor Supply | Jun 27, 2026 (Q2 FY2026 10-Q) | 232 | 2,154 | **1,922** |

Bolded negatives = net cash.

## Build-up

**TJX** – Cash $6,004 (reported as "cash and cash equivalents," no separate short-term investments/restricted cash). Debt = current portion of long-term debt $1,000 + long-term debt $1,871 = $2,871. Net debt = 2,871 − 6,004 = **−3,133**.

**Ross Stores** – Cash $4,288 (reported "cash and cash equivalents"; restricted cash of ~$69 is disclosed separately and excluded). Debt = current portion of long-term debt ~$241 (≈$241.5 classified in current liabilities) + long-term debt (non-current) ~$777 = ~$1,018 (footnote: ~$1.0B Senior Notes outstanding). Net debt = 1,018 − 4,288 = **−3,270**.

**Lowe's** – Cash $3,172 (cash and cash equivalents; $235 of short-term investments excluded). Debt = current maturities of long-term debt $2,352 + long-term debt, excluding current maturities $35,204 = $37,556. Commercial paper/short-term borrowings excluded per your definition (no short-term borrowings line at 7/31/26); finance-lease liabilities and operating-lease liabilities excluded. Net debt = 37,556 − 3,172 = **34,384**.

**Tractor Supply** – Cash $232 (reported "cash and cash equivalents"). Debt = current portion of long-term debt $0 + long-term debt $2,154 = $2,154. Excluded: finance lease liabilities ($10 current + $43 non-current) and operating lease liabilities. Net debt = 2,154 − 232 = **1,922**.

## Sources
- TJX Q2 FY2027 earnings release / 10-Q (balance sheet Aug 1, 2026): https://www.tjx.com/docs/default-source/investor-docs/quarterly-results/tjx-second-quarter-fiscal-year-2027-earnings-press-release.pdf
- Ross Stores Q2 FY2026 10-Q / earnings release (Aug 1, 2026): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/745732/000074573226000041/rost-20260801.htm
- Lowe's Q2 FY2026 earnings release / 10-Q (Jul 31, 2026): https://corporate.lowes.com/sites/lowes-corp/files/q2-2026-earnings/lowes-q2-2026-press-release_0.pdf
- Tractor Supply Q2 FY2026 10-Q (Jun 27, 2026): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/916365/000091636526000059/tsco-20260627.htm

Note: Ross's current-portion/non-current split is derived from the 10-Q debt footnote (~$1.0B Senior Notes, $241.5M current) and the balance-sheet "long-term debt" line; figures are rounded to the nearest million. If you intended the upcoming Q3 filings (which will be dated in late Oct/early Nov 2026 for TJX, Ross and Tractor Supply, and Oct 31 for Lowe's), those weren't yet reported when this data was gathered.
